pipeline_caveat: Thin design: 2 assignment units (schools), no never-treated school, every cohort from 2013 on treated. CSA (not-yet-treated, universal base 2010) is the equal-weight mean of ATT(2011,2011) and ATT(2011,2012) (Columbia vs NYU); the NYU 2013 cohort has no comparison. BJS imputes only Columbia 2011-2012 treated rows (cohort-year FE for 2013+ have no untreated rows). CSA SE is NA: clusters are the school x cohort cells, within which each RC 2x2 influence function sums to zero, so did returns NA for every clustered cell SE (csa_note is empty). TWFE leverage fails the screen (G_eff < 10, L_max > 0.25).
notes: Table 7 column 2. Outcome: act = count of extracurricular activities listed. Sample: entering cohorts 2000-2018. Design: graduates of Columbia Business School and NYU Stern (LinkedIn public profiles, MBA entering cohorts 2000-2018); repeated cross-section of students assigned to two stable groups (schools). Treatment gnd = grade non-disclosure, on for Columbia entering cohorts >= 2011 and NYU cohorts >= 2013 (code.R commented construction, line 702; confirmed in the shipped data: constant within school x cohort, absorbing, no switch-offs). Authors' regression felm(y ~ gnd | educYearStart + nyu | 0 | clust), clust = school x entering-cohort cell; no controls, no weights. id_var = school (the assignment unit and the unit FE, equivalent to the authors' nyu FE); time_var = entering-cohort year. Two adoption cohorts (Columbia 2011, NYU 2013); no never-treated school and no always-treated school; from 2013 on every cohort is treated, so the TWFE estimate uses already-treated Columbia cohorts as controls for NYU. Modern estimators are identified only for Columbia's 2011-2012 cohorts (NYU 2011-2012 is the only untreated comparison in a treated period); the NYU cohort has no clean comparison. data_provenance original: Tables 7-8 use the actual profile data (README; employer and position recoded to numbers), unlike Tables 1-6 (synthetic). No article text or PDF is available: published values are taken from the authors' log (logFile.pdf, TABLE 7 / TABLE 8 output, 'this will match paper'), and table/column labels come from the code and log.
